ayahs.translationUrdu: ایک گروہ کو اللہ نے ہدایت دی اور ایک گروہ پر گمراہی ثابت ہو گئی۔ انہوں نے اللہ کو چھوڑ کر شیطانوں کو اپنا سرپرست بنا لیا اور سمجھتے ہیں کہ وہ ہدایت پر ہیں۔

words.dictionaryUrdu: مُسْرِف حد سے بڑھنے والے کو کہتے ہیں۔ یہاں کھانے پینے اور دوسری نعمتوں کے استعمال میں زیادتی کا مفہوم ہے۔

auditNotes.noteEnglish: Follows verse iʿrab on ishtighal: the second group is the object of an omitted verb, with حَقَّ and its clause explaining it.

QAC calls the noun PN; here the definite plural denotes a class of devils, as supported by both English translations and the root note. The draft retains the packet noun type and avoids treating this plural as a personal name.
The shadda on initial mīm reflects connected recitation after final mīm of أَنَّهُم. The dictionary base is مُهْتَدٍ.
The word-level lemma بُنَىّ suggests a diminutive; the context and root card give the plural بَنِي in construct with Adam. The singular teaching lemma is اِبْن.

Both translations retain mosque. The provided tafsirs connect the instruction to each performance of prayer; the draft uses that contextual sense in translation and retains the place sense in the word entry.
The third-person pronoun is understood as referring to Allah here, as in the two Arabic tafsirs.
